sessionTitle: Develop a conversational search experience without rebuilding your app

announcements.name: Elastic Agent Builder is now generally available
announcements.shortDescription: previously in technical preview, it can now be used for production workloads.
announcements.longDescription: Elastic Agent Builder, which powers agentic search using AI agents, was announced as generally available after being in technical preview for a while, meaning it can now be used for production workloads. The presenter introduces a demo using an e-commerce camping gear website for a company called Wayfinder, whose product descriptions and titles were created with generative AI and whose search is powered by Elastic. The demo showcases chat-based, hybrid, and lexical search capabilities.

announcements.name: Elastic is natively available on the Azure Marketplace
announcements.shortDescription: deployable through the Microsoft Marketplace without separate procurement or additional vendor relationships.
announcements.longDescription: Elastic is natively available on the Azure Marketplace, deployed, managed, and built through the Microsoft Marketplace, allowing customers to go from zero to a production-grade AI search deployment without leaving the Azure ecosystem, without a separate procurement motion, and without managing additional vendor relationships. When paired with models from the Microsoft Foundry model catalog, such as Azure OpenAI or other catalog models, Elastic provides grounded, relevant, and trustworthy AI answers powered by your own data rather than just the model's training data.

announcements.name: Every tool built in Agent Builder is exposed as an MCP tool and accessible via API
announcements.shortDescription: agents and tools can be called from any application with an API key.
announcements.longDescription: The presenter notes that any tool created in Elastic Agent Builder is officially an MCP tool, so with an API key it can be accessed from any other application you're building. This is demonstrated in the context of creating a 'Get Customer Profile' tool that wraps a workflow taking a User ID input, which is then assigned to a new 'Trip Planner Agent' configured with custom instructions to search the product catalog and generate trip plans.
